reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

To register, visit https://t.co/zcnB4V65fG.

There’s no doubt that President Trump’s reckless wars have increased prices here at home. Last month, fuel used to heat homes jumped over 15%, risking higher bills as we head into the winter months. We need to stop the fighting abroad to lower costs for American families.

Election Day is here and casting your ballot is one of the great privileges of our democracy. Thousands of Americans fought to bring equal voting rights to the whole electorate in this country, and I hope you all exercise your civic duty and make your voice heard.

In November, we recognize Military Family Appreciation Month, a time to commend the loved ones of our service members. While the men and women in uniform dedicate themselves to our country, their families also support our troops through their sacrifices and patriotism. Thank you

A year ago, I introduced the Behavioral Health Crisis Care Centers, legislation to expand access to one-stop crisis stabilization centers that provide behavioral health services, housing support, and wraparound care under one roof. With our country’s behavioral health crisis system stretched thin, we must equip our communities with resources to better respond to the nationwide mental and behavioral health crisis, and this bill does just that.

Dolores Huerta was a motivating, courageous figure in the labor movement, paving the way for thousands of workers by creating a more just system of economic justice and opportunity. Her dedication to peaceful protest on behalf of the United Farm Workers proves the power of a single voice in our democracy. May her legacy be an inspiration to us all.

In Renton, I toured the King County Wastewater Treatment Plant, where an average of 90 million gallons of wastewater is treated per day, serving communities in Auburn, Bellevue, Issaquah, Kent, and Renton. I continue to support federal funds to support their services and supply https://t.co/haAWCx4toY

Thanks to @WashingtonTrade for having me at their Seattle office to discuss international trade. Having commerce hubs in our communities builds our businesses and workers, and I will continue to work on the federal level to resolve supply chain constraints, remove harmful tariffs, and improve domestic ports.

I stopped by New Frontier Aerospace in Kent to see their work to build rocket engines, spacecraft, and aircraft in our community. The Clean Water Act has been fighting water pollution for over 50 years. By setting wastewater standards, maintaining water quality, and improving pollution treatment, more Americans and wildlife are able to enjoy our nation’s water sources. https://t.co/iwVMseLMiJ

Since December 2024, American families have added to their monthly expenses, including $222 more on electricity, an extra $256 on rent, $758 more spent on gas, $211 added to the grocery bill, $852 more on childcare, and $929 spent on family health care coverage. That’s over $3,000 that could be spent paying off student loans, adding to your child’s college fund, or saving for a home.

My constituents can’t afford these extra costs under the Trump administration.

A year ago today, I introduced the Voluntary Grazing Permit Retirement Act, legislation to expand market-based, cooperative tools to reduce conflicts between domestic livestock grazing and other critical uses of public land, like wildlife habitat, clean water, hunting and fishing. Our public lands are a shared inheritance, and this bill gives ranchers and conservation partners a fair, voluntary path to resolve long-standing conflicts and restore fragile ecosystems.

Last night, President Trump signed an executive order waiving sanctions on Russia mandated by Congress in the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act, just two days before the law was set to take effect. By waiving these sanctions, President Trump is yet again siding with his dictator friend Putin and leaving President Zelensky and the Ukrainian people to fend for themselves.

Donald Trump’s pro-Russia platform undermines global stability and is not in the interests of the United States. Over the past two weeks alone, Trump cut an illegal diesel deal with Putin that will do nothing to rein in sky-high diesel prices that are a result of the administration’s war in Iran, falsely claimed he achieved an energy ceasefire, and refused to provide transparency regarding restrictions on Starshield. Trump continually shows he would prefer to support an authoritarian regime over a democratic country.

Trump is not operating in reality. Congress must reassert its authority, pass a sanctions bill that will actually support Ukraine, make it clear Trump is not above the law, and stop the President from running this country into the ground.

Today marks World Food Day, a time for those around the world to band together to fight hunger. 645 million people still face hunger, while almost 3 billion cannot afford a healthy diet. Investing in food banks and food assistance programs gives individuals the opportunity to put food on the table, and we must continue to support these initiatives.
Trump is fundamentally destroying this country. https://t.co/J9wA7M3LL4
The only way to end this war is to remove Donald Trump from office. https://t.co/izaMGq7RIE
Prices should be going down. Trump’s tariffs made sure they didn’t. https://t.co/5ZuKJ8UAfS

During October, we recognize Breast Cancer Awareness Month, a time to reflect on research, prevention and treatment, while supporting the hundreds of thousands of women impacted by this disease. Let this be a reminder to schedule your regular checkups of you and your loved ones.

Washingtonians are feeling the pressure as rising prices at the pump, in the grocery stores, and on their electric bills stretch household budgets thin.

Our country needs to focus on real challenges facing working-class families, like the soaring gas costs and tariff-driven price hikes. For a President who promised to end inflation on Day One, he certainly has proven that he is not a man of his word.
The American people are tired of President Trump's awful policies, grift, and corruption. https://t.co/mwrgVMf1w1

President Trump is dismantling our nation’s representative democracy as he continues to illegally target his political enemies. Mere weeks before the election, the Trump administration organized a raid on Representative Ilhan Omar’s home, constituting a clear abuse of power towards a sitting member of Congress. 

Congresswoman Omar has continued to be unlawfully targeted by this administration and I proudly stand with my colleague. No one in America should have to live under Trump's authoritarian rule. It is clear that Donald Trump is unfit for the presidency and must be impeached and removed from office.
Hapy Indigenous People’s Day to those in WA-09! Our indigenous communities have strong cultural and economic ties to our state, and I thank them for their contributions to Washington.

Thank you to DESC for welcoming me to their ORCA Center in Seattle. Over the past year, they’ve worked to respond to the opioid crisis in our community by helping people recovering from an overdose or seeking treatment. Their ability to provide medications, peer support, shelter and housing services is greatly beneficial to the greater Puget Sound Area, and I appreciate their continued hard work.

As we close out Mental Health Awareness Week, let this be a reminder that no one has to struggle in silence. I have dealt with my fair share of anxiety and chronic pain, and help is available. Mental health care is essential to maintaining the wellbeing of everyone in our community.

Thanks to those at @NAPCA_aging for having me at their Medicare Open Enrollment event at the IDIC Filipino Senior Center. It's always important that Washingtonian senior have access to vaccinations, food assistance, and other benefit programs, so I appreciate the work you're doing to keep our neighbors informed and healthy.
We have a country with major economic problems, and a president who is not concerned in solving them. https://t.co/iITRt150lm

Yesterday, I spoke at USCIS Field Office in Tukwila to commit to keeping families together and ending child detention. Thankful to have been part of an event in the Free Families Pilgrimage, a four-day interfaith walk of participants walking from former sites of Japanese incarceration to NWIPC in Tacoma. I will continue to work alongside out community partners to end family separation during immigration enforcement.

I unequivocally condemn ICE's shooting of a man in New York yesterday. Having a plainclothes officer draw a gun on a vehicle carrying a 5-year-old child in a residential neighborhood is reckless and does absolutely nothing to make our communities safer. People are terrified. ICE continues to execute chaotic, violent, and oppressive operations across the country, displaying an egregious level of incompetence. There must be accountability for the lives lost and the people injured as a result of this rogue organization.

https://t.co/gciXeXY8dL

“President Trump’s decision to launch an unnecessary war of choice with Iran has been disastrous. The war has resulted in the deaths of at least 19 service members and more than 800 wounded, over $40 billion in taxpayer dollars spent, thousands of civilians killed and injured, spiking gas prices, rising costs for everyday American families, and further regional instability. 

"The administration has not accomplished its strategic objectives after over seven months of war. The President is in denial and continues to insist on prosecuting this war despite a lack of evidence and coherent strategy for how the war can achieve its aims. It is far past time for President Trump to wake up to reality and evaluate the real options on the table that will best serve the interests of the American people and our regional partners. 

"It should be obvious by now that the only logical end to this war is a negotiated settlement achieved through diplomatic engagement by skilled negotiators, similar to the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action President Trump destroyed, before it continues to spiral even more out of control. We need actual diplomats working to achieve actual peace."

Donald Trump's remarks earlier this week about Iran taking out Los Angeles and San Diego are deeply disturbing. The President called for Iran to "take out" two American cities, a statement that would be unthinkable for any other president to make and further signs of his alarming mental decline and staggering lack of human decency. The costs of this war have been tremendous, and Trump's comments only underscore how dangerously out of touch he is with reality.

I had the chance to stop by @elcentro72’s Lift Zone in Federal Way. They’ve worked with Comcast to provide free WiFi and access to technology to assist working families with job applications, remote learning, schoolwork, and other essential needs. Thanks so much for having me. https://t.co/9QjF1tESe8
A lot of our country's problems are driven by President Trump's sheer awfulness. https://t.co/FCFf6YLTGB

I sat down with local leaders for an Energy Infrastructure Roundtable. Folks from UW's Clean Energy Institute, Clean Power Research, Grid Forward, the Pacific Northwest Hydrogen Hub, EDF Power Solutions, and Climate Solutions spoke with me about building a greener, more reliable electricity grid. Appreciate the chance.

Today marks the third anniversary of the horrific terrorist attacks on October 7, 2023. Over 1,200 men, women and children were brutally killed by Hamas, including 46 U.S. citizens. My thoughts are with the victims and their loved ones.

Further chaos, destruction, and violence is not the answer and will not make Israel safer. Israel must work with the United States and partners in the region to bring this conflict to an end and find a way ahead that creates a sustainable, safe, and prosperous future for Israelis and Palestinians alike.
